builtFrom: 11 hDrop sessions Jul-Oct 2025 (sweat-data/*.json) + Precision sweat test 2023 (1679 mg/L lab ceiling)

sweatSodiumConcentrationMgPerL.note: Stable across all sessions; drops toward 1000 at low sweat rates (duct reabsorption), rises toward 1400+ when gushing.

personalConstants.sweatOnsetDelayCool: 5-15 min below ~70F; sweat rate also falls with heat acclimation across a season

racePhaseTargets.note: Sangre 2026: 4:00 AM MDT start. Westcliffe late Sept: nights ~30s-40s F at altitude, days ~55-75 F. Race effort is easy/hike — closest analogs are the easy/long-run samples, not tempo runs.

phases.basis: Extrapolated below coolest samples; sweat rate and concentration both fall in cold. Round up, don't skip — respiratory + altitude losses continue.
Bracketed by 10/21 (1049 easy pre-dawn 68F) and 10/28 (766 easy 73F).
Matches the 6h long runs (1029-1509) and original app target.

racePhaseTargets.validation: hDrop was lost (Savage Race 2025) — validate with scale weigh-ins instead: weigh before/after the Build 3 6-hour long run (Aug 8) and each Ragnar day. Weight lost + fluid consumed = sweat rate; sodium follows from the known concentration constant.
